script: Microraptor was a small dinosaur with four feathered wings. It had long flight feathers on both its arms and its legs. It was about 80 centimeters long, roughly the size of a crow. In 2012, scientists found its feathers were black with a shiny sheen. It probably glided between trees, and may have been able to flap. It lived in what is now China about 120 million years ago.
